tips.text: Do the three daily Syndicate Alerts and sweep every medallion; they ignore the daily cap, so play to the cap first.
Rank up the moment the bar fills; opposed syndicates keep draining while it sits full.
Bring Loot Detector, Thief's Wit or Animal Instinct to show medallions on the minimap.
Pick Defense or Interception alerts on Grineer Galleon, Corpus Ice Planet or Sealab tiles; they pay more and hide medallions.
Spend any Perrin Sequence and Red Veil standing before you pledge Hexis.
Keep one pledge through the climb; switching to an opposed syndicate drains Hexis standing.
Keep medallions you do not need for the current rank; standing past the rank's cap is wasted.
Do not spend Hexis standing on anything else before Maxim; it comes out of the standing you need for rank-ups.
Grab medallions as a squad; one player's pickup counts for everyone.
Rank up mid-day to get a fresh set of Syndicate Alerts.
Players treat the standing as passive; most hit the daily cap just by playing normally.
